title: Chaining
summary: A good flicking run is not just individual flick speed. It is how cleanly the player moves from kill to kill without missing, over-microing, or leaving targets slowly.
cues: Judge time-to-kill across multiple kills, not only single flick speed
Protect initial flick accuracy even if raw speed dips slightly
Leave each target in a way that sets up the next kill cleanly
failureModes: Fast flicks paired with misses and extra micro-adjustment
Slow target exits after each kill
